description: The image displays three pie charts labeled "easy," "medium," and "hard," each representing the distribution of performance across four categories—N+K+, N−K+, N−K−, and N+K−—under the "Zero-Shot" evaluation setting. The "easy" chart shows N+K+ at 55.4% (teal), N−K+ at 38.3% (yellow), and N+K− at 4.6% (orange), with N−K− at 1.7% (red). The "medium" chart features N+K+ at 58.8% (teal), N−K+ at 35.4% (yellow), N+K− at 4.0% (orange), and N−K− at 1.8% (red). The "hard" chart indicates N−K+ at 37.9% (yellow), N+K+ at 37.3% (teal), N−K− at 18.1% (red), and N+K− at 6.7% (orange). A legend on the right maps the four categories to their respective colors: teal for N+K+, yellow for N−K+, orange for N−K−, and red for N+K−. Each pie chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size within each chart.
